visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Characters & Micro-Actions: A young man in a white jacket and a woman in a beige blazer are engaged in a heated argument with a waitress in a white blouse and red apron. The man points his finger aggressively while the woman in beige gestures with her hands as if explaining a grievance. The waitress stands with her hands partially raised in a defensive posture. Objects: A marble-topped counter is visible in the foreground with a tablet device used for ordering. Setting: The interior of a modern cafe with bright indoor lighting, blue-tiled walls, and shelves stocked with various bottles and jars. Text: Large yellow captions appear at the top. (2) Characters & Micro-Actions: No real people are present. Objects: A large animated graphic card fills the screen with a light blue background and wave patterns. Text: The Chinese characters '第三回合' appear in large pink font, with smaller text '站在別人的角度思考' below it. Setting: A digital graphic background with flat animation lighting. (3) Characters & Micro-Actions: The woman in the beige blazer is now wearing the red apron, serving as the waitress. She carries a coffee cup and places it in front of the man from the first scene, who is now a customer sitting with another woman in a blue top. The 'new' waitress smiles with a sarcastic expression while speaking. Objects: A white ceramic coffee cup and saucer are placed on a wooden dining table. A professional espresso machine is visible in the background. Setting: The same cafe setting, now focusing on the dining area with warm and bright lighting. (4) Characters & Micro-Actions: The man in the white jacket points back at the woman in the red apron, his facial expression shifting from annoyance to a realization. The woman in the red apron leans forward with a hand on the table. The original waitress stands in the background watching the interaction. Objects: The coffee cup remains on the table; cafe decor and plants are visible in the far background. Setting: Indoor cafe environment with high-contrast studio-style lighting.
